source_caption_text:
Drake getting Kawhi Leonard to join a music video boy band is still hilarious 😭😂

Back in September 2021, Kawhi made a surprise appearance in the “Way 2 S***” video alongside Drake, Future and Young Thug. Dressed in matching white outfits, the four delivered their own take on a classic boy band scene, with Kawhi’s straight face making the moment even funnier.

Directed by Dave Meyers, the video leaned into comedy, referencing everything from workout videos to romance novel covers. The group’s coordinated outfits and desert setting nodded to music videos by the Backstreet Boys and Boyz II Men. Kawhi joining in was easily one of its most unexpected moments. 

The track appeared on Drake’s Certified Lover Boy album, but this cameo deserves its own place in the memories from that era. Somebody needs to explain what the conversation was like when they asked Kawhi to do this 😭🏀
